title: Qualify conventioned exact and finite quantiles with paired covariance and Pearson correlation
commitMessage: feat: qualify conventioned quantiles and paired correlation

contribution.summary: Qualify Type-7 and nearest-rank sample quantiles over exact rationals and finite binary64, plus bounded centered covariance and Pearson correlation. Observe a compiled independent RED, pass 26 new GREEN and 71 total statistics tests with numeric/rational regressions, inspect local NuGet preview.3, and complete only M3-W02-C02-T1 plus R/G/V while leaving C02/T2 active for boundary qualification.
contribution.value: Make quantile definitions, probability representation, exact-vs-approximate loss, covariance denominators and independent Pearson oracles explicit without provider, Decision or AURA coupling.
debtChanges: The Type-7 interpolation and nearest-rank conventions are explicit; no implicit distributional quantile or VaR estimator is inferred.
Rational quantiles use exact probabilities with 4096-bit and 4096-observation budgets. Finite quantiles remain lossy binary64.
Paired covariance uses population N and sample N-1, with a centered compensated Pearson normalization and a 4096-pair bound.
Constant/degenerate vectors refuse in T1; typed undefined correlation and complete missing/NaN/singleton policies belong to T2.
No exact rational bivariate moments or general real-valued weighting, and no universal finite-precision error bound are promised.
The preview.3 package is local and inspected; no public feed, consumer Decision mutation, dw.discovery skill or BrokerReady claim is authorized.
contribution.nextAction: After RS046 succeeds, prepare M3-W02-C02-T2 for typed undefined Pearson correlations, remaining boundary and missing conventions, and consumer-facing integration policy.

achievements.achievement: Compile and observe the independent RED requiring explicit public quantile-convention and paired-correlation contracts absent in preview.2; retain durable RED evidence.
Implement provider-neutral exact-rational and finite binary64 quantiles and centered bounded finite covariance/Pearson correlation with explicit mathematical conventions.
Pass all 26 new GREEN cases and 71 statistics tests, quantities/numerics regressions, locked build, native-plan validation and local preview.3 package inspection; retain qualification evidence.
Qualify the accepted C02-T1 [0,10] p=1/4 Type-7 2.5/nearest-rank 0 and increasing-affine Pearson 1 oracles while preserving C02/T2 in progress.
